assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for a premium 2D landscape mobile action game, 16:9, 1536x864. Create an exquisitely painted cinematic nocturnal celestial temple ruin, painterly hand-crafted game art with rich shapes, similar finish to an award-winning 2D fantasy game. Deep midnight indigo sky, luminous turquoise aurora, distant floating islands and slender cathedral silhouettes, a huge broken celestial stone halo in the middle distance at 57% from left and 42% from top, fine warm brass engraved arcs. A pale crescent moon upper left, hanging dark foliage and carved stone at left and right edges. Large clearly traversable flat horizontal stone bridge across the ENTIRE width in the bottom 25%, its top surface at 73% image height, ornate teal inlays and golden cracks on the bridge front. Atmospheric mist below. Clear readable open space over the bridge for player and enemies. Layered depth, beautiful contrasting values, selective intense teal and amber rim lights, rich tactile stone, restrained motes. LEFT THIRD above bridge kept dark for game title overlay, RIGHT THIRD above bridge kept relatively uncluttered for lobby buttons. Camera is side-on, perfectly horizontal 2D platform game camera, not isometric, not overhead. No characters, no enemies, no UI, no letters, no words, no logos, no border. One complete polished game background, no mockup device.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D mobile game character cutout, true transparent background. A single full-body small anime celestial knight facing right in a dynamic ready stance, viewed side-on with slight three-quarter shoulders, ivory and midnight navy layered coat with pointed tails and elaborate small gold armor details, short silver hair, luminous turquoise scarf flowing behind to the left, leather boots, holding a long narrow turquoise energy sword forward to the right and down. Clear beautiful silhouette, highly polished hand-painted 2D game character sprite with crisp ink edges and selective painted soft shading, blue and gold rim lights. Entire figure and sword and scarf visible with transparent padding on all sides, feet on same baseline. Character fills 80% of image height. No ground, no shadows outside the character, no background, no lettering, no other characters, no UI, no particles, no vignette. This will be rendered at about 140 pixels high; prioritize readable silhouette and elegant large shapes over tiny detail.
